elements.label: Presenter head turn and nod while speaking

sfx_review.label: speech
sfx_review.note: Lands during 'smarter.'. Looks like narration residue in the voice-removed stem.

sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: A strong broadband onset in the gap before 'They're', with no visual change at that moment. Could be a breath or speech bleed, or a real SFX.

sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: In the pause between 'faster.' and 'And'. The code label is click but CLAP says swoosh_reverse. A short low-frequency onset with nothing visual at that moment.

pattern.description: A live-action founder speaking to camera in a medium close-up. The event is a small head turn and nod in time with the words 'getting faster.'
pattern.why_premium: Cinematic interview lighting and a shallow-focus set dressing (bookshelf, warm lamp in the corner) give the talking head a produced, editorial feel.

build_hint.gsap: Not an animation: live-action footage. Place the clip on its own track with no tweens.
build_hint.remotion: Use <OffthreadVideo> for the footage. No animated properties.

notes: The motion is the presenter's head only. Camera move is none. The diff box b02 (yellow lamp, top-right corner) shows only slight shimmer or handheld drift and is not listed as an element. None of the three SFX candidates matches a visual moment.
